proposal.reason: Main functional changes are to contribution/review automation: review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py add primary/additional module handling, role-based approval requirements, invitation withdrawal/reinvite rules, and /review-module commands; commit_message_squash.py and related workflows change when squash previews are generated/published based on Review Gate status. These are review-policy/workflow behaviors, while docs/skill text updates are supporting guidance.
